# Region study (supplementary, post-test; generated by scripts/analyze_region_study.py)

The 22 electrodes form nine scalp regions. Every one of the 511 non-empty sets of regions was trained for each of the 9 participants: 13,797 cross-validation runs on session 1 (three folds per set) and 4,599 final models scored on session 2. With all 22 electrodes the mean accuracy is 63.49% in cross-validation and 67.37% on session 2 (artifact-free trials). Chance is 25%.

**What can be claimed.** Cross-validation (CV) numbers use session 1 only, so they are test-free. Every session-2 number is exploratory: the study was planned after the main study's test results were known. The oracle picks the best set on session 2 itself, so it is an upper bound, not a usable method.

Intervals are 95% percentile bootstrap intervals over the participants (10,000 resamples, seed 690), as in the frozen plan.

## What each region adds (Shapley value, percentage points of accuracy)

A region's Shapley value is the accuracy it adds when it joins a set of other regions, averaged over all such sets so that every set size counts equally. The empty set scores chance (25%), so a participant's nine values add up to that participant's all-22 accuracy minus 25 points.

| region | electrodes | CV [95% interval] | CV per electrode | session 2, exploratory [95% interval] |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| L-premotor | FC3 FC1 | +2.35 [+1.31, +3.42] | +1.17 | +2.43 [+1.33, +3.62] |
| L-motor | C5 C3 C1 | +6.08 [+3.72, +8.19] | +2.03 | +5.83 [+3.39, +8.53] |
| L-somatosensory | CP3 CP1 | +5.16 [+3.60, +6.72] | +2.58 | +5.76 [+4.13, +7.32] |
| R-premotor | FC2 FC4 | +1.39 [+0.50, +2.24] | +0.69 | +2.28 [+1.16, +3.37] |
| R-motor | C2 C4 C6 | +5.70 [+3.83, +7.50] | +1.90 | +5.99 [+4.19, +7.84] |
| R-somatosensory | CP2 CP4 | +5.05 [+3.38, +6.85] | +2.52 | +5.54 [+3.82, +7.16] |
| mid-front | Fz FCz | +1.39 [+0.90, +1.89] | +0.69 | +1.53 [+0.78, +2.19] |
| mid-centre | Cz CPz | +4.99 [+3.45, +6.74] | +2.50 | +5.23 [+3.94, +6.61] |
| parietal | P1 Pz P2 POz | +6.39 [+3.82, +9.13] | +1.60 | +7.78 [+5.99, +9.60] |

Check: summed values equal all-22 accuracy minus chance to within 5.7e-14 points, for every participant, basis and class.

Region with the largest CV value, by participant: P1 parietal, P2 mid-centre, P3 R-motor, P4 parietal, P5 L-motor, P6 R-motor, P7 L-motor, P8 parietal, P9 parietal.

## Pairs of regions (Shapley interaction index, CV, pp)

Positive: two regions add more together than separately (they complement each other). Negative: they carry overlapping information, so the second adds less once the first is in. The three largest and the three smallest of the 36 pairs (all pairs: interactions.csv and analysis.json):

| regions | interaction [95% interval] |
| --- | ---: |
| R-premotor + R-somatosensory | -0.53 [-1.89, +0.77] |
| R-premotor + mid-centre | -0.75 [-2.18, +0.71] |
| L-motor + mid-front | -0.94 [-2.58, +0.60] |
| R-motor + R-somatosensory | -4.37 [-8.01, -1.25] |
| R-motor + parietal | -4.41 [-5.77, -3.08] |
| L-somatosensory + parietal | -4.49 [-6.78, -2.27] |

## How few electrodes: the best region set within a budget (session-2 accuracy, exploratory)

Three rules pick a region set with at most the budgeted number of electrodes:

- **own CV**: the participant's own best CV accuracy. Test-free.
- **population**: the best mean CV accuracy of the other eight participants, so the choice never sees the participant it is used for. Test-free.
- **oracle**: the best session-2 accuracy. It chooses with the test day: an upper bound only.

Ties go to fewer electrodes, then to the lower set number (`mask`). Each cell: mean session-2 accuracy (%); difference from all 22 electrodes (pp) [95% interval]; participants better/worse than with all 22.

## Region sets against the per-electrode relevance rule (session 2, exploratory, seed 0)

The region set is each participant's own-CV choice with at most k electrodes, so it may use fewer. relevance-k keeps the k electrodes with the highest training-day relevance (archived runs and the electrode-count sweep, seed 0, FP32). The last column repeats the comparison for the population rule.

## Pipeline check: the all-22 set against the archived full-22 run (seed 0)

Both follow the same recipe with the same seed. Session-2 predictions agree on 50.3-100.0% of trials, depending on the participant; accuracy differs by -2.85 to +7.77 pp. Training on other hardware can change the numbers slightly; large differences would point to a change in the pipeline.

## Files

- coalitions.csv: every participant and region set: electrodes, CV and session-2 accuracy and per-class recall, and session-2 accuracy on all trials
- shapley.csv, shapley_coarse.csv: Shapley values per participant, basis (cv or test) and region
- interactions.csv: pairwise interaction index per participant (CV)
- frontier.csv: each rule at each budget; frontier_choices.csv: the set picked for each participant
- relevance_comparison.csv: region sets against relevance-k
- figures: fig_region_shapley.png, fig_class_shapley.png, fig_budget_frontier.png, fig_scalp_shapley.png
